name: The Revolution
source: The Revolution is a game set in the future. You play as Ryker, or any name you choose. In this universe, you’ll find a lot of girls, alien and human, that you can date. As the name suggests you’ll join a revolution to take down the empire. Build your name in this expanding universe, explore planets, seduce your crew, upgrade your skills and make girls pregnant! Your final goal is the harem planet! This is a sci-fi/fantasy game, so you’ll find everything from cyborgs and holograms to elves and medieval places.
translation: 《革命》是一款以未来为背景的游戏。你可以扮演Ryker或你选择的任何名字。在这个宇宙中，你会发现很多可以约会的女孩，无论是外星人还是人类。顾名思义，你将加入一场推翻帝国的革命。在这个不断扩张的宇宙中建立你的名字，探索行星，引诱你的船员，升级你的技能，让女孩怀孕！你的最终目标是后宫星球！这是一款科幻/奇幻游戏，因此你会发现从机器人和全息图到精灵和中世纪地点的一切。
